regime: Fed hike being priced after a hot inflation report
takeaway: The 2-year Treasury yield closed up about 17 bp at 4.74% and the 10-year rose to near 5% after October inflation beat forecasts, a move that matches past patterns where a Fed hike gets priced in. Gold fell 2.6% to about $4,032 and silver 3.6%, while gold miners (GDX −5.4%) fell about twice as much as gold, close to the 'miners lagging gold' pattern. Stocks slipped modestly, the dollar rose and Brent settled near $91.
